speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a child with a 3-week history of fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain. To help me understand your condition better, where exactly is your leg pain located, and how would you describe the sensation?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia (likely ALL)

The combination of prolonged fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe nocturnal leg pain in a 4-year-old is highly suggestive of acute leukemia, possibly with bone marrow expansion causing bone pain. I need to confirm if there are any swollen lymph nodes or gum changes, and please request an urgent complete blood count with differential and peripheral smear. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_With_Differential.
